configs.A_prompt_v2:
# Model pair selected by the user; training hyperparameters remain unvalidated.
seed = 42

[data]
repository = "ncbi/TrialGPT-Criterion-Annotations"
train_patients = 37
validation_patients = 8
test_patients = 8

[compute]
platform = "google_colab"
# User reports A100 access through their Colab plan. Verify each runtime.
expected_gpu = "NVIDIA A100"
# Record actual VRAM and supported precision before choosing batch size.

[model]
target = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct"
draft = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct"
# Exact commits are pinned in configs/model_revisions.json after tokenizer preflight.
max_sequence_length = 2048
# Initially reject overlength examples; do not silently remove evidence.
overlength_policy = "reject_and_log"

[training]
class_weighting = "none"
class_weight_cap = 3.0
method = "lora"
epochs = 3
learning_rate = 0.0002
per_device_batch_size = 2
gradient_accumulation_steps = 4
lora_rank = 16
lora_alpha = 32
lora_dropout = 0.05
warmup_ratio = 0.1
weight_decay = 0.01
# Tune using validation only. Enable bf16 only on supported hardware.

[evaluation]
batch_size = 4
# Fixed overall label set and strict invalid-output policy; see docs/training-workflow.md.

[generation]
do_sample = false
max_new_tokens = 192
speculative_draft_tokens = 4

[benchmark]
input_lengths = [128, 512, 1024]
output_lengths = [32, 64, 128]
warmup_runs = 2
repetitions = 5

[prompt]
version = "v2"

[experiment]
id = "prompt_v2_unweighted"
